title: Investigation of the immune response in clinically relevant cytomegalovirus and polyomavirus infections in immunocompromised patients (ICB-Imm)
summary: With the help of the study on cytomegalovirus and polyomavirus infections in kidney transplant patients, we want to achieve a better understanding of CMV and BK virus infections after kidney transplantation. The main question here is how we can identify patients who have a particularly high risk of acquiring such an infection and develop new therapeutic approaches in the future.
conditions: Other viral infections of unspecified site

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients must be >= 18 years old and able to give informed consent in order to participate in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
- Persons who are in a dependent / employment relationship with the investigators, in particular employees of the clinics and institutes involved in this application
- Lack of capacity to consent, e.g. due to language barriers or mental illness
- Placement in an institution due to a court or official order
